text:
Maya: Hey team — customer (Morgan) is ready to start a 2-week POC. Main asks: can we automate key injection into their BYO-HSM during provisioning, and what's the pricing impact if they do per-operation vs reserved throughput?
Morgan: Need to validate attestation cert before we send keys. We can't proceed without HSM attestation from vendor.
Jon (SE): We can support automated key import via the Token API. Options: direct PKCS#11 import or wrapped key upload. For wrapped upload we need customer public key and an attestation chain.
Priya (CryptoOps): Attestation delay is the blocker. If vendor attestation arrives late, we can run a temporary KMS-proxy using ephemeral keys for test traffic, then swap to BYO-HSM after attestation.
Maya: Pricing question from customer: are HSM ops billed per-wrap/unwrap or per-token? They want to understand cost for high-rate signing (10k req/min spikes).
Sam (Infra): On Dedicated we can provision a throughput-rated pool. Billing model: reserved throughput monthly + overage per 10k ops. For Hosted BYO-HSM there's a passthrough per-op at hardware cost + 10% margin. I'll pull exact numbers.
Jon (SE): For the POC, suggest a hybrid: provision reserved pool sized for baseline, route spike traffic to temporary ephemeral keys to avoid huge overages.
Alex (Legal): Morgan — need to confirm contract clause for importing customer keys to our environment. Also want confirmation on key ownership and escrow for POC.
Morgan: We own keys. No escrow. We need proof of deletion after test. Also need FIPS 140-2 validation and vendor attestation.
Priya (CryptoOps): We can produce a one-off deletion audit: logs + signed deletion event. For FIPS, our runtime is FIPS-validated but BYO-HSM must be FIPS-compliant. Will need attestation artifacts.
Maya: Action items: Jon to draft the import flow diagram and required artifacts; Sam to list pricing numbers (reserved vs per-op); Priya to outline attestation / deletion audit; Alex to prepare contract language for POC. Can each owner share ETA?
Jon (SE): I'll have the import flow + test vectors by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Infra): Pricing numbers by end of week.
Priya (CryptoOps): Attestation checklist & deletion audit template by Wednesday.
Alex (Legal): Draft contract POC clause by Friday.
Morgan: Thanks — once we have attestation & pricing we can lock dates. Prefer start 2/6.
Maya: Noted. I'll sync with Customer Success to schedule kickoff once we have Jon's flow and Sam's pricing. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled test environment creation on 2354023600 — will post logs when ready.
Jon (SE): One more technical note: for wrapped upload use `openssl rsautl -encrypt -inkey vendor_pub.pem -pubin -in key.bin` and include `attestation.der`. Share sample command and we'll try in test env.
Morgan: We'll prep vendor attestation and the sample key bundle. Thanks everyone.
